violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training
violation_type.typical_finding: Out of ten files reviewed, four staff members did not have Pre-Service training available for review at the time of inspection.

finding_variants.text: Out of ten files reviewed, four staff members did not have Pre-Service training available for review at the time of inspection.
During inspection, 6 staff records were reviewed and not maintained.
A caregiver did not have her 8 hours of pre-service training done before caring for children.
The primary infant caregiver that has been employed for over 90 days does not have the required 24 hours of pre-service.
An employee has not completed any hours of pre-service training. There is no documentation of completed training available for review.

It was found that various training records were not available.  Some employee have not completed the 24 hours in annual training, annual reporting abuse is not in the training records, and one employee that only works summers, had no training hours.
